3D Toolkit Starter · Beacon Couriers

A runnable developer example · no arcade profile or score changes

← LITTLE BIG ARCADE

Deliver a little light.

Tap your half of the ground to walk around the stone wall. Move past the wall, fire three pulses at your beacon, then walk into the glowing gate. Player 1 uses the left half; Player 2 uses the right. Drag Camera mode to orbit; pinch, wheel or + / − to zoom. Falling crates use real Havok physics. The neutral guide follows nearby players.

Mouse and touch work. Each pointer keeps its owner until released. Physics and animation start only after pressing Start.

Ready · read the introduction and press Start.
